en.title: Eolymp Code
en.intro: An editor for competitive programming with code completion, a debugger and a console to run a solution and check it against tests.
en.missing: Eolymp Code is not available for {platform}. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux.

uk.missing: Eolymp Code для {platform} немає. Застосунок працює на Windows, macOS і Linux.
